item.title: NJC disowns report on 34 judges' integrity test

item.title: Gabon suspends national team, dismisses players after ‘disgraceful’ AFCON group-stage exit
item.description: The Gabonese government has indefinitely suspended its men’s national team following the group-stage exit from the ongoing Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) in Morocco. Announcing the sanction, Simplice-Desire Mamboula, the country’s acting sports minister, said veterans Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang and Bruno Ecuele Manga have been kicked off the team permanently. item.title: 2026 is a year of kabush kabash, Odumeje declares
item.description: Chukwuemeka Ohanaemere, the Onitsha-based pastor better known as Odumeje, has declared 2026 a year of “kabush kabash”. Addressing his congregation during the crossover service at his church, the controversial cleric described the coming year as a period of spiritual warfare. “2026 is a year of kabush kabash,” Odumeje proclaimed. item.description: Bala Mohammed, governor of Bauchi, has accused Nyesom Wike, minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), of plotting to destroy him. item.title: Police suspend enforcement of tinted glass permit policy over court order
item.description: The Nigeria Police Force (NPF) has suspended the enforcement of the tinted glass permit policy in compliance with a court order. The enforcement of the policy was scheduled to commence on January 2, 2026. However, Benjamin Hundeyin, the force spokesperson, said in a statement on Thursday that the policy has been suspended pending the hearing and determination of the substantive suit or the vacation of the order.
